description: Resolve a US reporter citation such as "410 U.S. 113" or "347 U.S. 483" to the case it refers to, with name, filing date, judges and citation count. No API key, no rate limit. Use when a brief, opinion or article cites a case by reporter and you need to know which case that is.

citation.description: Reporter citation: volume, reporter, page. E.g. "410 U.S. 113".

name: lookup_citation
title: Lookup Citation
